A Town That Runs on Appointment Books Needs Demolition That Fits Into One

c: Newmarket families book everything around a calendar, and demolition is no exception here. Around historic Main Street and the older downtown streets, it’s a small structure — a fence, a shed, a bit of deck — tucked behind a heritage home and torn down with the same patience given to anything else on the property. Through Stonehaven and Summerhill Estates, it’s the most common job of all: a dead above ground pool or a rotted deck cleared over a Saturday morning, gone by the time the family sits down for dinner. Near the Davis Drive corridor, it’s the occasional business property clearing an old structure between tenants. And whatever the property type, the same rule applies everywhere in town: evenings and weekends aren’t a special favour, they’re just when the work happens to fit. The 700+ five-star reviews behind Live Junk Free consistently describe the same thing — a structure gone before the weekend was over, and a workweek that never had to bend around it.

blocks.text: DEMOLITION FAQ
Demolition Services in Newmarket — Turnaround Questions, Dependable Answers

items.q: How much does demolition cost in Newmarket?
a: It depends on the structure — a fence section is inexpensive, a full above ground pool or a concrete pad costs more given the crew time involved — with weekend and evening execution included in the number, never added to it.

items.q: Can a pool or deck really be gone in one weekend?
a: For most single-structure jobs, yes. The walkthrough happens whenever suits you, the quote locks in, and the crew drains, tears down and hauls away inside a Saturday so Monday starts like any other Monday.

items.q: We can only be home in the evening — does that cost more?
a: No. Evening scheduling is standard practice here, not a special request, and it costs the same as a weekday daytime slot.

items.q: How careful are you with older buildings near Main Street?
a: As careful as they deserve. Original trim, foundations and features that stay get protected before anything comes down, and the pace matches the age of the property.

items.q: What's involved in concrete or flooring demolition?
a: The pad, walkway or patio gets broken up with equipment matched to its thickness, then hauled off in manageable pieces. The site is left level and cleared.
